newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB maintains Cultor buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB maintains Cultor buy.

text.p: CS First Boston said in a research note dated May 29 and received on Wednesday it maintained its buy recommendation on Finnish sweetener, bakery and feed group Cultor Oy.
Although Cultor had announced flat first-tertial results, sales in the company's growth portfolio had grown by over 25 percent, CSFB said.
"This positions the group very well to reach its earnings per share target of about 15 markka for 1997 and to grow strongly in the following years," it said.

"Despite Cultor's outperformance in 1996, the stock still trades at a 13 percent discount to its peers, while we believe that it should trade at a premium, given superior EPS growth prospects of 13 percent versus 10 percent for the average European sugar companies," it said.
Cultor's EPS was 12.7 markka in 1996. CSFB said its EPS target for 1997 was 15 markka and for 1998 17.9 markka.
